The '''Fligger system''' was located in the [[Kibilini sector/Legends|Kibilini sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was home to the [[Species/Legends|creatures]] known as [[Fliggerian firebeast]]s.<ref name="CSWE" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Fligger [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square Q-17.<ref name="TEA" />
